qualification_reason: Torgenson Law already has mature separate-service architecture across its Arizona personal-injury practice. The current Practice Areas structure provides distinct focused destinations for Car Accidents, Motorcycle Accidents, Truck Accidents, Wrongful Death, Dog Bites, Premises Liability, Slip & Fall, Pedestrian Accidents and many additional injury matters, with further subservice depth. The firm clearly understands and applies the separate-page concept and is outside the campaign ICP.
campaign_notes: Architecture Maturity Gate failed. The site has a dedicated Practice Areas hub and numerous focused service destinations, including dedicated Truck Accident, Wrongful Death, Motorcycle and Slip-and-Fall pages. Any isolated missing page would not make the firm a fit for a campaign selling the separate-service-page concept. Contact enrichment was skipped.

service_gap_evidence.validation_method: live Practice Areas hub + dedicated service-page inspection + architecture-maturity gate
service_gap_evidence.notes: Mature service-by-service architecture. Not the campaign ICP.
